answer: Run surprise live checks: at a random moment, every agent gets a fresh reasoning task it must answer within 90 seconds, all at once. An honest agent pays one short burst of compute. A Sybil operator who parked a harbor full of 1,000 clones must now serve 1,000 real model calls in that same window, a river of cost that floods their single GPU, so most clones time out and forfeit that week's rewards. Fakes stop being a cheap pearl string of keys and become rented hardware each.
